doctorAbout.full_description:
Dr. Aditi Rao is a Consultant Medical Gastroenterologist specializing in the diagnosis and treatment of disorders of the gastrointestinal tract, liver, pancreas, and biliary system. She completed her DM in Medical Gastroenterology from KLE Academy of Higher Education and Research.
Her expertise includes inflammatory bowel disease (Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis), irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), chronic diarrhea, gastrointestinal bleeding, liver diseases, pancreaticobiliary disorders, and gastrointestinal cancers. She is proficient in advanced diagnostic and therapeutic endoscopic procedures, including upper GI endoscopy, colonoscopy, biopsy, polypectomy, GI bleeding management, and foreign body removal.
Dr. Aditi Rao is committed to delivering evidence-based, patient-centered care with a strong focus on early diagnosis, prevention, and long-term digestive health.

doctorTreatments.title: Treatments
list: Gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and acid peptic disorders
Functional dyspepsia and irritable bowel syndrome (IBS)

Fatty liver disease, viral hepatitis, cirrhosis, and other chronic liver diseases
